annotations.title: Send a private-event inquiry to a venue

description: Sends a private-event or group-dining inquiry, on behalf of the person you are helping, to a venue that accepts inquiries from AI assistants (its handle comes from find_event_venues). Use it only when the person asked you to contact the venue, with the details they gave you. It lands in the venue's inbox as a new lead for the venue's team to review and answer directly; it books, holds and pays for nothing, and Excellent sends the guest no email. Give an email or a phone so the venue can reply. Answers only whether it was filed. At most 5 an hour and 20 a day per address.

event_date.description: Optional: the date they want, YYYY-MM-DD.

event_type.description: Optional: the occasion, e.g. "birthday dinner", "rehearsal dinner", "team offsite".

guest_email.description: The guest's email, for the venue's reply. Give this or guest_phone.

guest_name.description: The guest's name, as they gave it.

guest_phone.description: The guest's phone, for the venue's reply. Give this or guest_email.

message.description: Optional: anything else they want the venue to know, in their words.

venue.description: The venue's handle from find_event_venues (org/form), or its inquiry_url.

name: send_event_inquiry
title: Send a private-event inquiry to a venue
